name: UI & Navigation
description: Expo Router screens (home, local/online game, lobby, shop, leaderboard) and presentational components (GameBoard, ScoreBar, TutorialOverlay) that render the game and drive navigation.

name: State & Game Logic Hooks
description: React hooks that hold game and theme state; useGameEngine and useOnlineGame expose an identical interface so screens and board components work for both local and Firestore-backed online play.

name: Backend Services
description: Firebase integration layer wrapping anonymous auth, Firestore room/matchmaking/leaderboard operations, coin transactions, and audio, plus the Firestore security rules that govern backend access.

name: Domain Logic & Utilities
description: Pure, side-effect-free logic: the 3-tier AI opponent, game rule helpers, and AsyncStorage-backed local preference and stats persistence.

name: Shared Types & Constants
description: Foundational shared definitions imported across the app: the central game type hub, default parchment theme tokens, and the Firebase module shim used for TypeScript resolution.

name: Standalone Web PWA
description: Self-contained single-file browser game (index.html) with its service worker and PWA manifest, independent of the Expo mobile build.

name: Configuration & Build
description: Project, build, and deployment configuration for the Expo app and web hosting: app.json, eas.json, netlify.toml, package.json, tsconfig.json, babel.config.js, and .npmrc.

name: Documentation
description: Project guidance and design records: README, CLAUDE.md architecture notes, the enhancement prompt, and the superpowers phase-1 plan and design specs.
